summary: Iteration 28 — Tested Email Preferences UI, Admin Email Log, Stripe Checkout backend + frontend, and Payment success/cancel pages. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed. Frontend: all data-testids present, toggle persists, admin email log renders 71 rows with test-send working, Stripe Checkout Card flow completes end-to-end (POST /api/checkout/stripe-session returns 200 and browser navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL). No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_payments.py falls back to 'sk_test_emergent' when STRIPE_API_KEY env var is missing — acceptable for sandbox, but consider raising if unset in production.
PUT /me/email-prefs rejects an empty body with 400. Frontend never sends empty body but a future caller could hit this. Consider allowing no-op PUT to return current prefs.
PaymentSuccess.jsx MAX_ATTEMPTS=8 * 2s = 16s timeout. Fine for sandbox; production Stripe finalize could be slower — okay because timeout state still lets buyer poll from /profile.
server.py places /me/email-prefs and admin email log routes inline (~1400 lines in) — file already >5000 lines; consider splitting into a router module like stripe_payments.py.
seed_data_creation: Test emails 'e2e_test_<ts>@example.com' and 'e2e_ui@example.com' logged via admin_test (kind=admin_test) — expected & harmless. One stripe_pending_orders row created during backend session test (no order finalized since payment never completed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses localStorage key 'mercari_token' (not 'token'). Use fetch inside page.evaluate to login (external urllib gets 403). Address form on Checkout uses <Label>+<Input> pairs without htmlFor; get_by_label() doesn't work — use selector "div:has(> label:has-text('Full name')) input". place-order-btn requires filled address before triggering the stripe-session POST.

verification_evidence.email_prefs: toggle order=true->false persists across reload; sale/wallet/payout/dispute/system switches all present
verification_evidence.admin_email_log: page loads, 71 initial rows, +1 after admin-email-test-send; Failed only + Refresh present; sidebar entry visible
verification_evidence.stripe_checkout: Card default; Secure checkout by Stripe notice shown; no local card inputs; place-order-btn POST /api/checkout/stripe-session -> 200; browser then navigated to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1tZyVHkhlcUio2sgalISi46v6cPkrRxyKVbAnY6aoN23UPJUmZKsQr9xJ (aborted at route)
verification_evidence.payment_pages: /payment/cancel renders payment-cancel-page; /payment/success without session shows 'Missing session id' error state; /payment/success?session_id=cs_fake shows payment-status-heading (polling state)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all features working as spec.
